definitions.explanation: An outdoor extension of a building, typically with a roof, often used for drying laundry, keeping plants, or relaxing.

examples.japanese: ベランダ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: I hang the laundry to dry on the balcony.

examples.japanese: ベランダ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}っている→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I have flowers displayed on the balcony.

examples.japanese: ベランダ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{夜景|やけい}→夜景：10434_yakei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the night view from the balcony.

notes:
ベランダ is a loanword from Portuguese/English "veranda," referring to a covered outdoor extension of a building, typically an apartment balcony.

USAGE:
In Japanese apartments, ベランダ is typically used for:
- ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: hanging laundry to dry
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: airing futons
- ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: keeping plants

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バルコニー→バルコニー：06772_barukonii⟧: balcony (often used interchangeably, but technically has no roof)
- ⟦テラス→テラス：28798_terasu⟧: terrace (ground level)
- ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧: Japanese-style veranda (traditional wooden walkway along the edge of a house)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ベランダ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out onto the veranda
- ベランダ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to hang laundry on the veranda
